HediffDef.label: arcane ward
HediffDef.description: A ward of magic laid over the body. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a spell of the ward's own element passes through it, stronger, and the ward falls. Holds a share of shots and blows.

HediffDef.label: ward of flame
HediffDef.description: A ward woven of flame: its wearer does not burn, and fire on the body goes out. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a direct blow of fire puts out both the ward and the spell. Holds a share of shots and blows.

HediffDef.label: warmed by fire
HediffDef.description: Warmed through by a mage's held fire: the cold bites far less for a while.

HediffDef.label: stored heat
HediffDef.description: Heat taken out of fire and kept. The mage's next fire spell is stronger by it; kept too long, it slowly fades.

HediffDef.label: burning weapon
HediffDef.description: The weapon burns: blows add flame and may set the foe alight; shots may set what they hit on fire.

HediffDef.label: raging flame
HediffDef.description: The mage has lost hold of their fire. For a while new flame breaks out all round them and every fire near them burns higher and spreads faster - friend and foe are in it alike. A ward of fire keeps the mage out of it.

ThingDef.label: held flame
ThingDef.description: Fire held in its place by a mage: it never spreads, it smoulders and warms - and it burns the mage's foes who stand in it.

ThingDef.label: fire wisp
ThingDef.description: A small spirit of fire called by a mage. It throws flame at their foes until it burns out.

HediffDef.label: soaked
HediffDef.description: Soaked through by a mage's water: slower, hard to set alight - and the cold bites through wet clothes far sooner.

HediffDef.label: parched
HediffDef.description: Water drawn out of the body by a mage: weak, slow and dizzy until it comes back.

HediffDef.label: drawn water
HediffDef.description: Water drawn out and kept. The mage's next water spell is stronger by it; kept too long, it slowly seeps away.

HediffDef.label: ward of water
HediffDef.description: A skin of water held round the body. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; water passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but it keeps off being soaked. Holds a share of shots and blows.

HediffDef.label: weapon of water
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in water: blows soak the foe and knock them back a step.

HediffDef.label: chilled to the bone
HediffDef.description: The mage lost hold of their water and it soaked them through: slower, and the cold bites hard, for a few hours.

ThingDef.label: held water
ThingDef.description: Water held in its place by a mage: foes in it are soaked and slowed, and fire will not take here.

ThingDef.label: water spirit
ThingDef.description: A small spirit of water called by a mage. It throws water at their foes and puts out the fires near it, until it runs dry.

HediffDef.label: in the mist
HediffDef.description: Inside a water mage's tide: slowed, and it is hard to see through the mist to shoot.

HediffDef.label: skin of stone
HediffDef.description: Stone grown over the skin by an earth mage. Blows and cuts bite less; it is heavy to carry.

HediffDef.label: sucking ground
HediffDef.description: The ground of an earth mage clings to the feet like mud.

HediffDef.label: heavy limbs
HediffDef.description: An earth mage has poured weight into the body: every step is hard.

HediffDef.label: drawn weight
HediffDef.description: Weight taken from foes and kept. The mage's next earth spell is stronger by it; it slowly settles away.

HediffDef.label: ward of earth
HediffDef.description: A ward of earth. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; earth passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but it keeps the wearer from being rooted. Holds a share of shots and blows.

HediffDef.label: weapon of earth
HediffDef.description: The weapon is heavy with stone: blows land harder and may knock the foe senseless.

HediffDef.label: stone-bound
HediffDef.description: The earth took the mage when they lost hold of it: the limbs are stiff as stone for a while.

HediffDef.label: breathless
HediffDef.description: The air round them was stilled or pulled away. Hard to breathe, hard to move.

HediffDef.label: buffeted
HediffDef.description: A mage's wind beats at them: slow to walk and hard to aim.

HediffDef.label: drawn breath
HediffDef.description: Breath taken from foes and kept. The mage's next air spell is stronger by it; it slowly slips away.

HediffDef.label: ward of air
HediffDef.description: A ward of wind. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; air passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but it keeps off dizziness. Whoever strikes the wearer in close combat is thrown back.

HediffDef.label: weapon of air
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in wind: blows throw the foe back.

HediffDef.label: winded
HediffDef.description: The wind tore the breath out of the mage when they lost hold of it.

ThingDef.label: raised stone
ThingDef.description: A wall of stone raised from the ground by an earth mage. It stops feet and shots alike, and crumbles back into the ground after some hours.

ThingDef.label: wall of wind
ThingDef.description: A wall of wind held in its place by a mage. The mage's foes who try to cross it are thrown back.

HediffDef.label: rooted
HediffDef.description: The ground holds their feet: they cannot take a single step, though their hands are free to shoot and strike.

HediffDef.label: reeling
HediffDef.description: Spun through the air by a mage's wind and set down hard: the world will not stand still. Walking, aiming and working with the hands are all harder until it passes.

ThingDef.label: pool of water
ThingDef.description: Water a mage's spell left on the ground. It dries in a few hours.

HediffDef.label: dazzled
HediffDef.description: A flash of heat and light: the eyes will not clear for a while.

HediffDef.label: in the haze
HediffDef.description: The air shimmers round them: nothing stands where it seems to.

HediffDef.label: dust in the eyes
HediffDef.description: Dust in the eyes and the throat: hard to see, hard to aim.

HediffDef.label: mired
HediffDef.description: Mud to the knees: every step is fought for.

HediffDef.label: ward of steam
HediffDef.description: A ward of steam: its wearer is not scalded by steam nor burnt. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a direct blow of steam or fire puts out both. When foes are near, a little cloud wraps the wearer.

HediffDef.label: ward of storm
HediffDef.description: A ward of storm. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a storm passes it, stronger, and the ward falls. Whoever strikes the wearer is jolted and stunned.

HediffDef.label: ward of magma
HediffDef.description: A crust of molten stone: its wearer is not burnt and wades magma like warm mud - neither spends the other. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a direct blow of magma or fire puts out both. Whoever strikes the wearer is burnt.

HediffDef.label: ward of haze
HediffDef.description: A ward of haze. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; haze passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but it keeps off being dazzled. Bullets often pass through a shape of the wearer that is not there.

HediffDef.label: ward of bog
HediffDef.description: A ward of bog. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; a bog passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but the wearer does not sink nor stick. Whoever strikes the wearer is stuck where they stand for a moment.

HediffDef.label: ward of dust
HediffDef.description: A ward of dust. Magic of other elements is put out at the cost of its charge; dust passes it, stronger, and the ward falls - but it keeps dust out of the eyes. Whoever strikes the wearer gets dust in theirs.

HediffDef.label: weapon of steam
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in steam: blows scald and leave a puff of cloud.

HediffDef.label: weapon of storm
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in storm: blows jolt - machines worse - and sometimes stun.

HediffDef.label: weapon of magma
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in magma: blows burn and may set the foe alight.

HediffDef.label: weapon of haze
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in haze: blows dazzle.

HediffDef.label: weapon of bog
HediffDef.description: The weapon drips with mud: blows clog the foe and slow them.

HediffDef.label: weapon of dust
HediffDef.description: The weapon is wrapped in dust: blows grind and blind.

ThingDef.label: magma
ThingDef.description: Molten ground made by a mage. Whoever stands on it burns; it cools into rubble - or, poured as a wall, into stone.

ThingDef.label: magic moss
ThingDef.description: A living carpet of moss made by a mage. Friends on it mend and walk softly; fire will not take it; foes slip in it.

HediffDef.label: drawn into the mire
HediffDef.description: A mage's bog has them: the longer they stay in it, the deeper they sink - and when it closes over them, they choke. Out of the mire it slowly lets go.

ThingDef.label: mire
ThingDef.description: A bog made by a mage. Foes in it are gripped, slower and slower; whoever stays in it too long, or falls in it, is drawn under and chokes.

ThingDef.label: scalding steam
ThingDef.description: Steam from boiled water. Whoever breathes it is scalded, friend or foe.

ThingDef.label: marsh gas
ThingDef.description: Gas rising off a mage's bog. It does nothing at all - until fire, a burning body or a blast reaches it; then it goes off, and the gas round it after.

ThingDef.label: obsidian shards
ThingDef.description: Magma quenched by water, set at once into black glass. It cuts the feet of whoever walks over it.

ThingDef.label: glass shards
ThingDef.description: Sand fused by heat into glass. It cuts the feet of whoever walks over it.

HediffDef.label: wind at their back
HediffDef.description: Spells of the air cast one after another: each stage makes the next quicker and cheaper while the wind holds. A pause lets it drop (both set in the mod options, magic section).

ThingDef.label: spell rubble
ThingDef.description: Broken stone an earth spell left on the ground. It lies for days - longer than water - and the next earth spell nearby flings it.
